name: kapula
description: Kapula: phones as controllers for any game or desktop app — protocol, server, phone UI and a reference host

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/host
scripts.build:packages: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/server packages/phone && npm run copy-assets --workspace=packages/phone
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p apps/host && tsc --noEmit -p tests
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace=apps/host
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:packages && PW_E2E=1 playwright test --project=e2e
